qualifications: Peri Tzadik, Bo distinguishes outward compulsion from the inward root's willing acceptance.

Sotah 2a is quoted for its own tractate-order argument; Rav Tzadok's inward application is explicitly distinguished in context.
Shabbat 88b retains both the elixir-of-life and elixir-of-death alternatives.
Tzidkat HaTzadik 133 retains the qualification that sin may obstruct progression from shelo lishmah, as in Doeg.
Sha'arei Teshuvah 3:219 retains its possible-interpretation framing, witness motive, persistence in the same sin and relevant distinction concerning exposing hypocrites.
Sotah 28a is presented as the quoted source for Rav Tzadok's interpretation, without turning this editorial note into generalized practical advice.
